newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Star in regional paging services venture.
newsitem.headline: Star in regional paging services venture.

text.p: Star Telecom International Holding Ltd's wholly owned Star Telecom Holding Ltd has agreed to set up a venture with a third party International Wireless Communications Inc to invest and operate radio paging services in Southeast Asia, Star Telecom said in a statement on Monday.
Star Telecom will take a 30 percent of the venture for US$5.4 million and a U.S. investor, International Wireless, will take 70 percent for US$12.6 million, the statement said.

Star Telecom also said its wholly owned Star Telecom Overseas Ltd had agreed to transfer to the venture company the radio paging services it had developed in several Southeast Asian countries for US$4.5 million.
The company said its director considered "the arrangement a key step of the company's corporate development to expand into provision of radio paging services in Southeast Asia countries."
